title: Minimum Graph Homomorphism Counts at Fixed Density
exact_target: For a fixed finite graph $F$ and an $n$-vertex graph $G$ with at least $\rho n^2/2$ edges, determine the minimum possible number of graph homomorphisms $F\to G$, where homomorphisms need not be injective and need not preserve nonedges.
